argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const query = '{{ query }}'; const limit = {{ limit }} || 20; const ct0 = document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('ct0='))?.split('=')[1]; if (!ct0) return { error: 'Not logged into x.com (no ct0 cookie)' }; const bearer = 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAANRILgAAAAAAnNwIzUejRCOuH5E6I8xnZz4puTs%3D1Zv7ttfk8LF81IUq16cHjhLTvJu4FA33AGWWjCpTnA'; const headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + decodeURIComponent(bearer), 'X-Csrf-Token': ct0, 'X-Twitter-Auth-Type': 'OAuth2Session', 'X-Twitter-Active-User': 'yes', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const variables = { rawQuery: query, count: limit }; const features = { rweb_video_screen_enabled: false, profile_label_improvements_pcf_label_in_post_enabled: true, rweb_tipjar_consumption_enabled: true, verified_phone_label_enabled: false, creator_subscriptions_tweet_preview_api_enabled: true, responsive_web_graphql_timeline_navigation_enabled: true, responsive_web_graphql_skip_user_profile_image_extensions_enabled: false }; const url = '/i/api/graphql/YTkV8GjFNGfgnhRNP6kDbQ/ListSearchTimeline?variables=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(variables)) + '&features=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(features)); const resp = await fetch(url, { headers, credentials: 'include' }); if (!resp.ok) return { error: 'HTTP ' + resp.status + ' ' + resp.statusText }; const data = await resp.json(); const instructions = data?.data?.search_by_raw_query?.list_search_timeline?.timeline?.instructions || []; const results = []; const seen = new Set(); for (const inst of instructions) { if (!inst.entries) continue; for (const entry of inst.entries) { const items = entry?.content?.items || []; for (const item of items) { const list = item?.item?.itemContent?.list; if (!list) continue; const id = list?.id_str || list?.id; if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue; seen.add(id); results.push({ id: String(id), name: list?.name || '', members: list?.member_count || 0, followers: list?.subscriber_count || 0, description: list?.description || '', isPrivate: list?.is_private || false, url: 'https://x.com/i/lists/' + id }); if (results.length >= limit) break; } } } return { results }; }

async (intermediate) => { if (intermediate.error) return [{ id: '', name: '', members: 0, followers: 0, description: '', isPrivate: false, url: '', error: intermediate.error }]; return intermediate.results || []; }
